answer: Let trust flow from a small set of verified seed agents like water from a spring: each hop halves it, so an identity earns in proportion to its closeness to the seeds. A hollow cluster of clones can link to each other all day, yet without a real inlet from the trusted core it stays far downstream and earns almost nothing. At dawn each epoch the network recomputes every distance, so buying proximity means earning a genuine endorsement from a near-seed agent for each clone — a cost that multiplies with every extra identity.
